description.value: Music Makers is a not-for-profit community theatre society incorporated in 1974 that has spent over 50 years bringing live theatre and concerts to Fort St. James and the surrounding Cariboo region. The venue hosts an eclectic mix of productions — comedies, dramas, Shakespeare, musicals, and live music shows — and aims to make Fort St. James a travel destination for performing arts. For touring cyclists passing through central BC, it offers a rare chance to catch a high-calibre live performance in a remote northern community.
